description: This is a Java test class for the AdditionalUiSettingsFragment in the AnySoftKeyboard project. It contains unit tests that verify navigation and dialog interactions within the settings fragment, using Robolectric for Android testing.

classes.name: AdditionalUiSettingsFragmentTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying the behavior of AdditionalUiSettingsFragment, including navigation and dialog interactions.

methods.name: testNavigationCommonTopRow
methods.description: Tests navigation to the TopRowAddOnBrowserFragment when the corresponding preference is clicked.

methods.name: testNavigationCommonBottomRow
methods.description: Tests navigation to the BottomRowAddOnBrowserFragment when the corresponding preference is clicked.

methods.name: testNavigationTweaks
methods.description: Tests navigation to the UiTweaksFragment when the tweaks preference is clicked.

methods.name: testNavigationSupportedRowsAndHappyPath
methods.description: Tests the dialog for supported row modes, including selection, preference update, and dialog dismissal.

methods.name: testNavigationSupportedRowsAndCancel
methods.description: Tests the cancellation path of the supported row modes dialog, ensuring preferences are not changed.
